context:
Goal: you can always answer "what have I asked for this card over time" (D243's outcome).
Problem (rule): D243 says "There is no fourth writer" of a price. server/send_routes.py's `_master_take_off` writes a live price and records no posting, so those prices drop out of the history. How many prices it has posted is unmeasured. After #1043, D243 says so, and no debt holds it.
Based on (read): lane prose-cuts-banchi, banchi #1043 (review round 3 PASS).
Departs from: banchi main, where the master take-off records no posting — a records it; b narrows D243; c logs a debt only.
home: banchi D243 (every posted price is recorded once)
lane: coordinator starts a banchi lane: _master_take_off records each posting (D243)
lastAnswer: a (11:22 CST Nov 6): fix the code so the master take-off records each posting. Routed to the coordinator 11:30 CST; open until the banchi PR merges.

options.gain: Every posted price is in the history, as D243 promised.
options.how: A banchi lane makes `_master_take_off` call `Postings.record()` at the point it writes the price, with a red test first.
options.label: Fix the code: record the posting

options.how: D243 says the master take-off is outside the history.
options.label: Narrow D243
options.lose: Prices posted by the master take-off are lost from the history for good.

options.how: Write a debt record; fix later.
options.label: A debt only
options.lose: Each day's master take-off prices are lost meanwhile; D243 calls this history perishable.

title: banchi: the master take-off writes a live price and records no posting, against D243. Fix the code, narrow D243, or log a debt?
why: Recommended: a. D243 says each unrecorded posting is lost for good, so a later fix cannot get them back.
